answer: Make reputation conduct like copper: every graded answer a node lands is a ripple that other established nodes must receive and countersign before it travels upstream. A river cannot be faked from its mouth — each countersignature cites the hash of the work that caused it, so a thousand cloned agents produce a thousand dead-end trickles that connect to no current. Consensus reads the network like a watershed: what reaches the sea is only the water that provably fell on real ground, and copper wiring between honest nodes is the only conductor the ledger accepts.
